k:箸.mnemonic: Someone (者) snaps a bamboo (竹) stem into two thin sticks and uses them to pick up his rice. Chopsticks.

k:糾.mnemonic: Ten (十) strands of thread (糸) wound around each other into a rope. Pull on one to find out where it leads. Twist (ask, investigate, verify).

k:唾.mnemonic: A mouth (口) waters at the smell of dinner, ten thousand (万) tiny drops gathering on the tongue. Saliva (sputum).
k:唾.hint: Watering at the smell of dinner.

k:穫.mnemonic: The flowers (艹) have gone to seed, the grain (禾) is ripe, and vessels (隻) wait at the river to carry away what the field gave. Harvest (reap).
k:穫.hint: Boats waiting for the ripe crop.

k:酢.mnemonic: Stir the wine jar (酉) with a stick (｜) and let a taste slide (ノ) onto your tongue: left too long, it has turned sharp and sour. Vinegar (sour, acid, tart).

k:憩.mnemonic: You stop work, flop down with your tongue (舌) hanging out like a dog and catch your breath (息). Recess (rest, relax, repose).

k:諮.mnemonic: Unsure what to do next (次), you ask a wiser mouth (口) to say (言) what it thinks before you decide. Consult with.

k:遡.mnemonic: A salmon takes the river path (辶) backwards, swimming for a month (月) against the current to where it first hatched as a tiny sprout (屮). Go upstream (retrace the past).

k:痢.mnemonic: Bad oysters: a sickbed (疒) placed close to the toilet, and the only one to profit (利) is the paper seller. Diarrhea.

k:鯨.mnemonic: A fish (魚) as big as the capital (京) city: when it surfaces, the fountain from its back is seen for miles. Whale.

k:韻.mnemonic: A poet is paid compensation (賠) for every line whose last sound (音) matches the one before: moon, June, spoon. Rhyme (elegance, tone, sound).

k:詔.mnemonic: Whatever the emperor chooses to say (言) from the throne need not seduce (召) or persuade anyone: it is written on a scroll and obeyed. Imperial edict.
k:詔.hint: A scroll read from the throne.

k:羨.mnemonic: You gaze across the ocean (洋) at your neighbour's yacht, keenly aware of what you lack (欠). Envious (be jealous, covet).

k:搾.mnemonic: Fingers (扌) close hard around a lemon until the juice runs out through the hole (穴) cut in its end. Squeeze.

k:芯.mnemonic: At the heart (心) of a candle runs a strand twisted from dried flowers (艹) and grass, the part that takes the flame. Wick.

k:衷.mnemonic: Sewn into the lining of an old (古) garment (衣), right against the chest, is a letter holding the wearer's deepest feelings. Inmost (heart, mind, inside).
k:衷.hint: A letter sewn into the lining.

k:酎.mnemonic: The wine jar (酉) is boiled down, and the strong clear spirit is poured out in a small, careful measurement (寸): one thimble is plenty. Distilled sake.

k:虞.mnemonic: The fortune-telling (占) cards show tiger stripes (虍) in your future. Now every rustle in the long grass makes you uneasy. Apprehension (fear, concern, uneasiness).
k:虞.hint: Every rustle might be a tiger.

k:窯.mnemonic: A hole (穴) in the hillside with flames (灬) roaring beneath: the potter bakes his clay sheep (羊) inside until they are hard. Kiln (oven, furnace).
k:窯.hint: Clay animals baking in a hillside.

k:陪.mnemonic: The lord sits on the mound (阝). His attendant must stand (立) below with mouth (口) shut, bowing and following wherever he goes. Obeisance (follow, accompany, attend on).

k:賓.mnemonic: Under the roof (宀) of the government ministry (省), one visitor is shown to the best seat and presented with a gift of shellfish (貝) money. V.I.P. (guest).

k:萎.mnemonic: Flowers (艹) left on the table through a five-hour committee (委) meeting: by the end they hang their heads, and so does everyone else. Wilt (wither, droop, lame).

k:賦.mnemonic: A warrior (武) goes from door to door collecting shellfish (貝) money from every household for the lord's army. Levy (ode, prose, poem).
k:賦.hint: A soldier collecting at every door.

k:𠮟.mnemonic: A mouth (口) wide open and a wooden spoon (匕) wagging: grandmother has caught you with the jam jar. Scold (reprove).

k:畝.mnemonic: After a long time (久) behind the plough, the rice field (田) is combed into neat raised lines of earth. Furrow (ridge, rib).

k:繕.mnemonic: A virtuous (善) grandmother with needle and thread (糸) closes the hole in every sock rather than throw it away. Darning (repair, mend, trim).

k:貪.mnemonic: A man hides shellfish (貝) money under his hat (𠆢) and still eyes his neighbour's every tool (具), wanting that as well. Covet (indulge in).

k:哺.mnemonic: The old (古) nanny has one task (用), done for generations: hold the baby close and feed it until it sleeps. Nurse (suckle).

k:寡.mnemonic: Under the roof (宀) only one part (分) of the couple remains. She eats alone, with her own self (自) for company. Widow (minority, few, little).
k:寡.hint: One place set at the table.

k:煎.mnemonic: Stand in front (前) of the flames (灬), shaking the pan until the beans crackle and turn dark. Broil (parch, roast, boil).
